name: Bauhaus Form & Function
tagline: A complete ten-slide Bauhaus workshop where primary geometry carries the message from principles and metrics to process, comparison and case study.

palette.description: Warm cream and near-black alternate with disciplined red, blue and yellow geometric fields.

typography.style: Source-matched Montserrat regular/bold and Open Sans regular/bold embedded as WOFF. Original 800 declarations resolve against the source 700 face; uppercase tracked labels and exact tight display line heights are retained.

best_for: Design workshops, creative education, process explanations, comparisons and concise case studies that benefit from disciplined primary-color geometry.
avoid_for: Dense financial tables, long academic reports, photographic portfolios, or content that cannot be split into short statements and compact groups.

source_inspiration.name: Form & function — Slides team
source_inspiration.notes: All ten public pages rebuilt as native positioned HTML text, original SVG geometry and one independently replaceable square photograph. Preserves the observed 1280×720 canvas, source block coordinates, palette, Montserrat/Open Sans WOFF font faces and typography. Original example content, page order and the case-study photograph composition are retained. Includes independent keyboard/button/hash/touch navigation and overview; no dependency on the source presentation runtime. Example metrics are demonstration content, not independently verified research.
